description: This source file defines the DeviceOwnerReceiver class, which extends DeviceAdminReceiver, and handles events related to device owner provisioning such as completion of profile provisioning. It includes logic to set a profile name and launch the main activity upon profile setup completion.

classes.name: DeviceOwnerReceiver
classes.description: Extends DeviceAdminReceiver to handle device owner related events, particularly profile provisioning completion.

methods.name: onProfileProvisioningComplete
